warnings: *** AXIS DECISION REVERSED 2026-07-25 -- BREAK LINE, NOT AN EXPANSION JOINT *** An earlier pass on this house read the double vertical line between grids ⑧ and ⑩ on S-01/S-02/S-03 as a structural expansion joint, concluded that grid ⑨ did not exist, and adopted a 10-line / 9-bay grid. THAT WAS WRONG. Re-examined at 4.5x magnification, the double line carries the standard ZIGZAG BREAK SYMBOL at mid-height: it is a drawing interruption, used on the 1:100 sheets to omit the repeating middle bays so the 36 m building fits the paper. Grid ⑨ is hidden inside the break, which is exactly why ⑧ and ⑩ appear adjacent and why 7→8 and 10→11 both still measure 3.60 m. E-02 (หน้า23, แปลนไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง, 1:125) and A-03 (หน้า04, ผังบริเวณ, 1:125) are drawn at a smaller scale, fit the whole building without a break, and BOTH print the full axis 1..11 at a uniform 3.60 m with grid ⑨ present and ten ห้องนอน. THE CORRECT GRID IS 1..11, UNIFORM 3.60 m, 10 BAYS, 36.00 m OVERALL. Every sheet is consistent with this once the break is understood; nothing in the set actually conflicts. Consequence for this folder: element lists extracted from the 1:100 sheets record what is DRAWN (10 column lines), not the whole building (11). Grid-9 elements have been added by the repeating module and are flagged inferred_from_repeating_module.

GRID-9 ELEMENTS ADDED 2026-07-25 by the repeating module, after the break-line correction above. S-01 draws 10 column lines because the break hides grid 9; the real building has 11. Three footings (F2/F1/F2 on rows ค/ข/ก, pedestal C1) were added at grid 9 to match every other line, flagged inferred_from_repeating_module at confidence 0.75. They are NOT read off the sheet.

Footing layout is fully regular: 30 footings on a 10 x 3 grid. Outer rows ค and ก carry F2 on every column line; the middle row ข carries F1 on every column line. Every footing sits on pedestal (ตอม่อ) mark C1. No footing is missing and no dummy grid is needed.

Each footing is drawn as a SOLID rectangle inside a DASHED rectangle. Per the legend on this sheet these are two alternative foundation types superimposed, not one footing: solid = ฐานรากแบบตอกเข็ม (pile footing), dashed = ฐานรากแบบฐานแผ่ (spread footing). รายการประกอบแบบ items 4.1/4.2 on the same sheet make the choice soil-dependent -- spread footing if the bearing capacity is at least 8 t/m², pile footing if less. So a single grid position legitimately has BOTH an F-mark drawn as pile type and as spread type; element_id here records the printed F mark, which is shared by both options.

grid_ref uses the spec §4 format (row letter first, then column number, e.g. "ค-1"). NOTE a corpus inconsistency: houses 02-05 wrote structural plan grid_refs in the opposite order with a prefix ("grid2-gridF"), which contradicts the Axis order rule added to the spec on 2026-07-13. This house follows the written spec. The older files have not been touched.

Columns 10 and 11 carry confidence flag grid_pos_unresolved_expansion_joint: their absolute grid positions are unresolved because the expansion-joint gap between grids 8 and 10 is not dimensioned anywhere in the set (see หน้า00_gridline.json). Their footing marks and row assignments are NOT in doubt -- only the absolute x position.

This sheet also carries two further views extracted to separate files: the รายการประกอบแบบ specification notes (_view3_notes.json) and the separate toilet-block footing plan (_view2_footing_plan_สุขา.json), which uses a DIFFERENT grid master.
